test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

Only two people sit to the left of F. F sits second to the right of G. E sits second to the right of F. C sits fourth to the right of B. D sits second to the left of C. A sits an immediate right of C.

How many people sit between B and G?
solution:
**Given:** Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

1) Only two people sit to the left of F.

2) F sits second to the right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca7fd265213bff6cb55edf3b23fb9fe3811427ed7c93b81f7330a1abe5060ad7.png] 

3) E sits second to the right of F.

4) C sits fourth to the right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32d4daa56a910f81cf3a9fba03356391d138e2a69e8f7e0b9697cbfbb29c0121.png] 

5) D sits second to the left of C.

6) A sits an immediate right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d98d98790454dbac333859ee2ddf9688ba789885f84adffc02d23e5252c04671.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, no person sit between B and G.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
